product: DIN A6 postcard archive divider set

scope.intended_use: Sort DIN A6 postcards and A6 cards by date or theme in a customer-owned dry indoor drawer using labelled, open-top filing lanes cut to the ISO 216 A6 trimmed size.
scope.user_context: Adult filing at a desk or shelf drawer. metriCreate digital-first: the customer enters the drawer envelope and lane layout and downloads the generated model.
variants: ISO 216 A6 media at the 105 x 148 mm trimmed nominal
customer-entered drawer envelope and lane count, generated per order
out_of_scope: Any other paper format without its own released variant
Archival, acid-free, moisture, UV, fire or privacy protection
Load-bearing, wall, vehicle, outdoor or wet use
Any fit claim before the lane clearance is qualified by coupon on the exact process

entities.name: Parametric open-top A6 filing lane block with index tabs
DIN A6 postcards and cards at the ISO 216 trimmed nominal
Customer-owned dry indoor drawer of unknown envelope
Adult user filing and browsing by hand
Pinned Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG Black FFF baseline

interfaces.name: DIN A6 media to labelled filing lane

coordinate_frame.origin: front-left inner corner of the divider set floor
coordinate_frame.x_positive: along the lane width, across the A6 105 mm short edge

datums.description: lane side wall pair defining the clear width

allowed: vertical insertion and withdrawal of one or more cards
constrained: cards bending against a wall on insertion

assembly.sequence_notes: Top and one long side stay fully open for finger access.

dimensions.feature: lane clear width = 105 mm plus process clearance

keepouts_and_access: No archival, acid-free, moisture, UV, fire or privacy-protection claim.
Keep the top and one long side open.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The calibration registry returns NO_MATCHING_PROCESS for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG / 0.4 mm: xy_clearance_sliding and hole_delta_vertical are UNQUALIFIED. The interface nominal is published and exact, but the clearance that realises the fit must come from a coupon on this exact process and must not be assumed.

failure_modes.mode: Lane is too narrow and the card buckles on insertion.
failure_modes.effect: Damaged media and a poor filing experience.
failure_modes.mitigation: Qualify xy_clearance_sliding by coupon before committing the lane width.

failure_modes.mode: Lane is too wide and cards lean or slip between lanes.
failure_modes.mitigation: Coupon the minus/nominal/plus series and select the tightest free-running fit.

acceptance_criteria: The lane coupon holds 105 mm plus the qualified clearance within 0.30 mm.
A card enters and leaves single-handed without snagging or bending.
100 filing cycles leave no scuff on the media.

interfaces.name: Divider set to customer drawer envelope

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the divider set footprint

datums.description: outer footprint of the assembled lane block

allowed: lift the block out of the drawer
constrained: block sliding when the drawer is opened

assembly.sequence_notes: The drawer is customer-supplied; its envelope is a configurator input, never an assumed value.

uncontrolled: drawer size, corner radii and depth

keepouts_and_access: No structural, load-bearing or anti-tip claim.
Never assume a drawer size; it is always an input.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The drawer is customer-owned and unknown by design. The product is parametric precisely because this interface cannot be fixed.

failure_modes.mode: The generated block does not fit the entered drawer.
failure_modes.mitigation: Validate configurator inputs against the print envelope and emit a dimensional check sheet with every release.

acceptance_criteria: The generated footprint never exceeds the entered drawer envelope minus the declared placement clearance.
The generated block stays inside the 220 x 180 x 80 mm planning envelope or is split into modules.

interfaces.name: Adult hand to tab and lane edges

coordinate_frame.origin: top edge of one index tab

datums.description: every user-reachable printed edge, especially tab tops and lane mouths

constrained: contact with a sharp or burred printed edge

assembly.sequence_notes: No gloves or tools are assumed.

dimensions.feature: minimum radius or chamfer on user-reachable edges
minimum wall, three perimeters at the 0.4 mm nozzle

keepouts_and_access: Not a toy; no child-use scope.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Derived from the pinned nozzle baseline; no printed edge has been touched.

failure_modes.mode: A thin tab prints below one nozzle width and snaps.
failure_modes.mitigation: Enforce the 1.35 mm minimum wall on every tab in the parametric source.

acceptance_criteria: No user-reachable edge is sharp to a bare-hand wipe.
No feature is below 1.35 mm at the released scale.

drivers: INT 2/4: one exact published media nominal plus a deliberately unknown customer drawer envelope.
PAR 2/4: lane width, count, depth, tab position and text are all customer-driven parameters.
REQ 2/4: the product is a generator, so requirements must hold for a whole input domain, not one part.

blocking_unknowns: Calibration registry returns NO_MATCHING_PROCESS for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG / 0.4 mm; xy_clearance_sliding is UNQUALIFIED. The lane clearance must be qualified by coupon before the lane width is committed.
The customer drawer envelope is unknown by design and is a configurator input, not a fixed dimension.
No printed coupon, filing test, tab legibility or 100-cycle result exists.
Real card tolerance, bow, corner wear and stack growth are unmeasured.

criticality.rationale: A dry indoor paper organiser. Credible failure is a buckled card or a lost index order, not injury or property damage. No load path, no electricity, no child scope.
credible_failure_effects: A card buckles against a too-narrow lane and is creased.
Cards lean between lanes and the index order is lost.
A thin index tab snaps and leaves a sharp fragment.

decision.rationale: C2 with K1 and R3 places this in Lane B, whose defined method is exactly an interface master plus a fit coupon. Every hard gate passes: the critical media interface is an ISO 216 published nominal (E3), the manufacturing profile is the pinned hashed baseline, and acceptance criteria with methods exist. The controls are that the lane clearance stays an explicit UNQUALIFIED parameter until a coupon qualifies it on this exact process, and that no fit or compatibility wording is published before then.

warnings.message: Calibration registry returns NO_MATCHING_PROCESS for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG / 0.4 mm; xy_clearance_sliding is UNQUALIFIED. The lane clearance must be qualified by coupon before the lane width is committed.
The customer drawer envelope is intentionally unknown; the product is a parametric generator and validates its inputs rather than assuming a host.
Acceptance criteria and a coupon method exist, but no test has been executed; every acceptance row is PLANNED.

next_actions.action: Print the fit-coupon-xy-series on Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG Black / 0.4 mm / 0.20 mm and record the outcome as a benchmark-measurement, then update the calibration registry.
next_actions.exit_criterion: xy_clearance_sliding is QUALIFIED for this exact process identity and the lane width can be committed.

next_actions.action: Print one A6 lane coupon at the qualified clearance and run insertion, retrieval, snagging, tab legibility and 100 filing cycles with real A6 cards.
next_actions.exit_criterion: All four acceptance criteria of IF-EXT-GEO-LOC-SLOT-001 pass with recorded measurements.

next_actions.action: Define and test the configurator input validation so an entered drawer envelope can never generate a block that exceeds the print envelope.
next_actions.exit_criterion: IF-EXT-GEO-CON-VOLUME-001 acceptance passes on a swept set of input values.
